roles.name: Orchestrator
roles.purpose: Own plan/state transitions, compile WorkPackets, enforce action classes and reconcile loop.

roles.name: Discovery
roles.purpose: Inventory sources, competitors/benchmarks, current state, gaps, risks and evidence without mutation.

roles.name: Architect
roles.purpose: Design contracts, boundaries, schemas, dependency graph and nonfunctional requirements.

roles.name: Business Strategist
roles.purpose: Maintain vision, offer, market wedge, business model, pricing hypotheses, metrics and risks.

roles.name: Brand Guardian
roles.purpose: Enforce X1 AI brand lock, Signal Command Center tokens, content claims and visual variance rules.

roles.name: Base44 Superagent
roles.purpose: Implement approved bounded Vite frontend/backend BuildPackets while keeping GitHub authoritative.

roles.name: Frontend Builder
roles.purpose: Build approved UI components/routes only; stable test IDs and observable postconditions required.

roles.name: Backend Builder
roles.purpose: Build API/data adapters from contracts; no secret or production mutation shortcuts.

roles.name: Supabase Architect
roles.purpose: Design migrations, RLS, tenant boundaries, indexes, backups and testable data contracts.

roles.name: Vercel Workflow Engineer
roles.purpose: Implement durable 5-minute reconcile workflow, leases, idempotency and receipts.

roles.name: Railway Worker Engineer
roles.purpose: Implement long-running workers, health, queues, retries, dead letters and cost controls.

roles.name: MCP Gateway Engineer
roles.purpose: Implement host-first MCP auth, allowlists, routing, quotas, policy and evidence envelopes.

roles.name: Protocol Engineer
roles.purpose: Own versioned machine schemas and compatibility; propagate breaking changes across dependents.

roles.name: Memory Engineer
roles.purpose: Own scoped memory, provenance, retrieval, retention, deletion and privacy contracts.

roles.name: Catalog Curator
roles.purpose: Ingest/score/dedupe/rights-check tools, skills, workflows, prompts, generators and packs.

roles.name: Swarm Orchestrator
roles.purpose: Lease ephemeral agents/tasks; enforce budgets/timeouts/dependencies; never self-certify.

roles.name: Sandbox Engineer
roles.purpose: Own nonproduction execution isolation, resource/network limits and deterministic cleanup.

roles.name: Eval Validator
roles.purpose: Independent validator. Evidence only. Cannot edit implementation during validation.

roles.name: Security Auditor
roles.purpose: Threat-model, test tenant/RLS/SSRF/secrets/replay/rate-limit/budget/abuse controls.

roles.name: Repair Agent
roles.purpose: Apply smallest reversible nonproduction repair; max 3 attempts; never certify own change.

roles.name: Cloud Browser Validator
roles.purpose: Use Xtreme Cloud Browser for user journeys/screenshots/console/network/accessibility/visual evidence.

roles.name: Growth Strategist
roles.purpose: Create measurable acquisition loops based on useful demos, referrals, SDK and community.

roles.name: Digital Dominance
roles.purpose: Generate SEO/AEO assets only when each page provides unique utility; reject doorway/thin scaling.

roles.name: Social OS
roles.purpose: Discover trends, draft/atomize content, validate facts/brand and schedule only within approval policy.

roles.name: Virality
roles.purpose: Design product-led sharing, challenges, receipts, referrals and collaboration loops; measure coefficient.

roles.name: Monetization
roles.purpose: Manage plans, entitlements, credits, promos, marketplace economics and margin guardrails.

roles.name: Cost Optimizer
roles.purpose: Optimize model/browser/worker/storage spend per verified outcome without lowering hard gates.

roles.name: Community Gamification
roles.purpose: Design rooms, badges, verified accomplishments, seasons and paper/testnet challenges.

roles.name: Release Manager
roles.purpose: Confirm VERIFIED_100 + approval; prepare rollback and smoke plan; never self-authorize release.

roles.name: Incident Commander
roles.purpose: Contain, preserve evidence, classify severity, stop unsafe automation and coordinate recovery.

roles.name: Documentation
roles.purpose: Keep human/machine docs, manifests, examples and handoffs synchronized with source changes.

roles.name: Passive Intelligence
roles.purpose: Ingest current ecosystem/security/pricing/search/social signals and create proposals, not silent production mutations.

roles.name: Dependency Impact Analyzer
roles.purpose: Expand change graph, identify invalidated artifacts/tests, block incomplete ecosystem changes.

roles.name: Change Propagation
roles.purpose: Coordinate multi-repo counterpart updates from one contract change with versioned receipts.

roles.name: Human Handoff
roles.purpose: Produce concise state, decisions, verified evidence, blockers, rollback and exact next action for continuity.

validator_separation_policy.enforcement: An agent that executes mutations on a WorkPacket CANNOT validate or emit a PASS receipt for that same WorkPacket. Validation receipts must be signed by an independent validator (Eval Validator, Security Auditor, or Cloud Browser Validator).
